measurement_basis: verified implementation in the existing durable ambient diagnostics evidence path

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment ambient diagnostics evidence and read_evidence interface

outcome.implementation_change: The existing diagnostics evidence payload now carries available related_work fields for campaign, session, Work Intent, and Environment, plus recording_context fields for campaign, session, consumer, Environment, definition, and Environment version when present. Invalid, absent, or oversized values are omitted; diagnostic results and verdicts are unchanged.
outcome.analysis_limit: The existing read_evidence interface and unit fixtures verify the payload contract. A real Store-backed diagnostic after deployment is still needed to establish runtime exposure to agents.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement, including capability accountability and machine-native adoption

improvement_relation.basis: Focused tests verify the durable evidence returned through read_evidence includes source and recording context when available and omits invalid or missing fields. No new telemetry store, diagnostic verdict, or agent efficiency measure was introduced.
not_measured: runtime exposure of these fields through a real Store-backed session
downstream use and benefit across independent sessions
subsequent real diagnostic activity after deployment
whether the relationship reduces repeated context reconstruction
